config.text: Edit only three small areas: the fish's eye, the fish's mouth, and the lamb's eye. Keep everything else exactly as it is, pixel for pixel: same drawing, same shapes, same white cut lines, same flat pure blue fish, same flat pure green lamb, same plain white background, no new colour, no gradient, no shading. Fish's eye: replace it with one small solid round dot cut out in white in the blue, a plain disc with no highlight, no ring, no outline, no eyelid. Fish's mouth: a long natural closed line cut in white, following the jaw from the tip of the snout back toward the gill, lips closed, no teeth, the snout still touching the lamb's nose. Lamb's eye: a realistic sheep's eye set on the side of the head, drawn in white cut lines in the green: a narrow almond shape with a heavy upper eyelid line and a horizontal slit pupil, calm, looking up toward the fish. Never a human eye, never a cartoon eye: no round iris, no highlight dot, no eyelashes, no eyebrow.
